rows.name: 概要
目的
報告
結果

グランデルにいるアルマが霧乃獣になってしまった
住人に危害を及ぼす前にアルマを倒そう（仮）
霧乃獣となったアルマをすべて倒す（仮）
グランデルの被害は最小限に抑えられたようだ（仮）

To defeat the Fog King, a high-density ether field will be
necessary. To obtain the High Ether Crystal required,
the team will need info from the townspeople.
Ask Gran Dell militia members about High Ether Crystals.

Ask the Gran Dell militia member on the Ramparts
about High Ether Crystals.
Speak with Sarja at Heroes' Rest.
Return to Radam.
Find a [System:Color name=item ]High Ether Crystal[/System:Color].

With information about High Ether Crystals in hand,
the heroes are a step closer to defeating the Fog King.

The information led you to a High Ether Crystal.
It's time to enhance the Monado Replica at Radam's.

You found a promising lead on High Ether Crystals.
Search the hitherto mostly uncharted caves around the
Forbidden Hushland.

Go to the caves around the Forbidden Hushland
in search of a [System:Color name=item ]High Ether Crystal[/System:Color].
Find High Ether Crystal (TBC)

You've found a High Ether Crystal. Return to Radam
to start the Replica Monado remodelling process.

Tsukuku seems to have dropped his precious mirror on
the small islet at Tranquil Tarn. He can't seem to work
without it; best lend him a land.

Search for [System:Color name=item ]Tsukuku's Mirror[/System:Color] on the small islet
at Tranquil Tarn.

Return [System:Color name=item ]Tsukuku's Mirror[/System:Color] to Tsukuku resting
at Tranquil Tarn's edge.

Tsukuku has reclaimed his mirror. Now he can admire his
own reflection and get the esteem boost he deserves.

To make up for interrupting her survey work,
you decide to hear out Rutoru's request.
Time to displace some Kromars.

Defeat the 3 Kromars in the vicinity of
Xen's Thoroughfare.
Return to Rutoru.

Speak to Rutoru at the far end
of Xen's Thoroughfare.

With the Kromars out of the way, Rutoru was able
to finish her survey task. She looks very relieved.

Having finished her survey, Sakusaku's mind is more on
researching the ecosystem than heading back. But
she might reconsider if you solve her riddles.

Collect an item that drifts and digs,
but has no eyes.
Deliver the [System:Color name=item ]Sky Mole[/System:Color] to Sakusaku.

Defeat a highly "fer"-ocious enemy
with the colour of a plant .
Return to Sakusaku.

You solved Sakusaku's riddles. It looks as though she'll
honour her promise and tag along with you.

Though Setichi planted stakes to use in her
survey, they keep going missing, making her job
impossible. Won't someone lend her a hand?

Plant [System:Color name=item ]Setichi's Stake[/System:Color] on the lakeshore
by the side of the Junks.
Return to Setichi.

Defeat the thief in the higher reaches of
Navvir Highland to recover Setichi's stolen stake.
Return to Setichi.

With the stake thief defeated, Setichi could complete
her survey. One less thing for her to worry about...

Nanana wishes to have a shout from the terrace of
the rope bridge, but it's currently occupied by Rhoguls.
There seems to be no way forward but to evict them.

Defeat the [System:Color name=item ]Bodacious Rhoguls [/System:Color]on the terrace of
Whisperwind Crossing.
Return to Nanana.

With the Rhoguls gone, Nanana was able to express
himself, after which he decided to join the party.

Hachocho finished his survey work, only to be spotted by
monsters at the last second. He dropped his precious
charm in his hurry to escape. Let's help him out.
Look for [System:Color name=item ]Hachocho's Charm [/System:Color]at Nerthis Necropolis.
Return the charm to Hachocho.

Hachocho appears to treasure his charm more than life
itself. He's regained his composure now that it's back.

Follow Noino's cryptic instructions and slay the
"odious fiend" he speaks of to prove your worth.
Defeat the [System:Color name=item ]Thing-a-Majicker XIII[/System:Color].
Return [System:Color name=item ]Noino's License[/System:Color] to Noino.

The "Proof" Noino spoke of turned out to be a simple
Ponspector license, belonging to Noino himself.

Enemies are closing in on a Ponspector.
Save them before they get eaten.
Defeat the [System:Color name=item ]Slobbering Antols[/System:Color] attacking the Ponspector.

Talk to the Ponspector to make sure
they're OK.

It seems the enemy was drawn in by the
incense. At least Torotoro was all right.

Shiishii was ready to eat her snack after a hard day's
surveying, when, tragically, it slipped into the nearby
lake. Help is in order.

Defeat the shoal of [System:Color name=item ]Whapol Sardi[/System:Color] that ate
Shiishii's snack.
Return to Shiishii.

Collect 3 of the [System:Color name=item ]Morrow Cobs [/System:Color]that Shiishii
wants to eat.
Deliver the food to Shiishii.

You vanquished the monsters and relieved Shiishii's
hunger. She looks pleasantly satiated.

Wanawana, the current Ponspector Chief, unfortunately
forgot to specify where he would hold his meeting.
It's time to unite all the Ponspectors in one place.
Gather the other 11 Ponspectors.
Return to Wanawana.

Get back the memo from the [System:Color name=item ]Cutpurse Igna
[/System:Color]north of Clear Sky Bluff.
Return the memo to Wanawana.

The Ponspectors are united and the memo is back. Now
Wanawana is ready to explain what they're doing here.

The Ponspectors have come to the Shoulder in search
of treasure. Finding it will be their last request for you.
Let's help them track down the loot!

Search for the treasure in the ruins at the back of
Nerthis Necropolis.

Defeat the monster guarding the treasure in the ruins
at the back of Nerthis Necropolis.

Investigate the treasure chest in the ruins at the back
of Nerthis Necropolis.

The Ponspectors have found their treasure! This will
ensure a prosperous future for the Archaeology HQ.

Exterminate the ether organisms that have spawned
abnormally in two locations on Navvir Highland.
Exterminate the wind elementals.
Exterminate the water elementals.
Return to Treanna.

The two kinds of ether organism have been eliminated.
Monsters should no longer be drawn to their presence.

Gannett has requested you assist with her research.
She needs someone to try mining an ether deposit with
the Common Ether Pick she's working on.

Excavate an ether deposit using
the [System:Color name=item ]Common Ether Pick[/System:Color].
Return to Gannett.

With the ether pick you received from Gannett, you
can now mine gems directly from ether deposits. Neat!

Haemlin is lacking the manpower to deal with stockpiling
food. Hunt some Eks, collect Eks Iron Hearts, and place
some Rainbow Carrots to aid future hunts.

Defeat Makna Eks at Navvir Highland
and collect 4 [System:Color name=item ]Eks Iron Hearts[/System:Color].

Gather 3 [System:Color name=item ]Rainbow Carrots[/System:Color] to be used
as bait for the Makna Eks.

Head to north-western Navvir Highland and place the
Rainbow Carrots there to lure out the Makna Eks.
Return to Haemlin.

You delivered the Eks Iron Hearts to Haemlin. Some
of them are sure to be cured and stored for later.

Laennar has asked you to help with three jobs around
the camp. Ease his burden by completing them for him.
Complete the quest "Plump Pickings".
Complete the quest "Praying Caterpile Control".
Complete the quest "Supplant the Noble Brogs".
Return to Laennar.

Food shortage is the next big issue the Companions are
facing, but you won Laennar the time to figure it out.

Gianna is having trouble gathering Plump Wildgrass
in the required amounts. Helping her out seems like the
right thing to do...

Collect 5 bundles of [System:Color name=item ]Plump Wildgrass [/System:Color]in the area
between Navvir Highland and the Purifying Falls.

The harvest was a success...this time around.
It seems the scarcity was caused by Caterpiles.

Praying Caterpiles have been breeding in extraordinary
numbers. Fedorto doesn't feel up to the task of
taking them out, so the job falls to Melia and friends.

Defeat 3 [System:Color name=item ]Praying Caterpiles[/System:Color] in the vicinity of
Navvir Crossroads.

The Caterpiles have been winnowed out.
It seems they were congregating to eat wildgrass.

Noble Brogs have been appearing in extraordinary
numbers. Robert cannot take them all out on his own,
so Melia and friends must take charge.

Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Noble Brogs[/System:Color] in the vicinity of
the Purifying Falls.

The Brogs have been successfully dealt with.
It seems they were gathering to hunt Caterpiles.

Gather Pororo's scattered favourites from all across
the Giant God's Shoulder and bring them to her.

Search every nook and cranny of the Giant God's Shoulder
for [System:Color name=item ]Pororo's Favourites[/System:Color] and bring them to her.

Check with Pororo to see whether her [System:Color name=item ]Favourites
[/System:Color]are now all accounted for.

You got back all of Pororo's favourite foods. Now she
can meet her "esteemed person" without mortal fear.

Rescue the High Entia woman who is being
attacked by Antols.
Defeat the Antols to rescue the woman.
Make sure the woman is OK.

You dealt with the Antols and saved Leafa
the Armu herder. She returns to Gran Dell.

The old ID card you found was once Laban's brother's.
He asks you to find the heirloom bangle the man used
to wear, too.

Search for the bangle on the high ground
at Shoulderstone Scree.
Give the [System:Color name=item ]Warped Bangle[/System:Color] to Laban.

You've reunited Laban and his family's heirloom bangle.
He vows to wear it with pride.

Shoo-shoo climbed a tree to escape a monster, but a
moment of carelessness caused her to fall and injure
herself. The situation calls for a helping, caring hand.

Gather a [System:Color name=item ]Peppity Herb[/System:Color] from atop the
Cragmaw Caverns.
Give the [System:Color name=item ]Peppity Herb[/System:Color] to Shuushuu.
Take out the [System:Color name=item ]Revenant Volff[/System:Color] that are after Shuushuu.
Return to Shuushuu.

Thanks to Nene, Shuushuu won't be giving up her
tree-climbing pursuits. Here's hoping she'll be careful...

In return for finding a catalyst for him to use in his
tool upgrades, Lott offers to improve your Ether Pick.
Find him a Cerulean Shard in Barouh Ruins Cave.

Look for a [System:Color name=item ]Cerulean Shard[/System:Color] around
Barouh Ruins Cave.
Hand in the [System:Color name=item ]Cerulean Shard[/System:Color] to Lott.

With your new Reinforced Ether Pick, you'll be able to
find better gems from ether deposits than before.

Melekanze is studying the fauna of the Giant God's Shoulder,
but seems to have run into some trouble. Shulk will
have to take photos of the monsters in her place.

Take a photo of a [System:Color name=item ]Glow Deinos[/System:Color] in the
Forbidden Hushland during the night.

Take a photo of a [System:Color name=item ]Dozy Eluca[/System:Color] at the plateau
near the Purifying Falls during the day.
Return to Melekanze.

Melekanze was overjoyed seeing the pictures you took.
The less said of her follow-up request, the better...

It appears Paguls near the Junks' crash site are running
amok. To allow residents to forage in peace, you'll have
to eliminate the Paguls along the lakeshore.

Take out [System:Color name=item ]3 Clamouring Paguls[/System:Color] in the area of the lake
where the Junks landed.
Return to Mithril.

Exterminating the nearby Paguls brought peace to the
lake. With any luck, the fishing can now safely resume.

The old Machina who took in Margo has sustained leg
damage and apparently cannot move. The party decides
to retrieve a First-Aid Kit from the Junks.
Head for the Junks and acquire a [System:Color name=item ]First-Aid Kit[/System:Color].
Head for Nerthis Necropolis and look for Hersel.
Persuade Hersel to give you the [System:Color name=item ]First-Aid Kit[/System:Color].
Give the [System:Color name=item ]First-Aid Kit[/System:Color] to Margo.

You delivered the First-Aid Kit to Margo. That should get
the old Machina back on his feet in no time.

The ancient city of Gran Dell is peppered with
rubble. Hover Stone would make it easy to remove.
Collect some Hover Stone!

Collect 3 pieces of [System:Color name=item ]Hover Stone[/System:Color] at Soltnar
Seal Island, Pillar Knoll and Scapular Lance.
Give the [System:Color name=item ]Hover Stone[/System:Color] to Selsetana.

With the rubble gone, Gran Dell looks much
nicer. Its former residents would be proud.

Nestor has been searching Gran Dell with his friends
for flowers to place at a grave. It's too dangerous for
him to leave the walls...but that's where you come in.
Search Lamentation Ridge for 3 [System:Color name=item ]Dawn Smiles[/System:Color].
Hand the [System:Color name=item ]Dawn Smiles[/System:Color] over to Nestor.

You found the Dawn Smiles without too much trouble.
Nestor placed them on the grave and prayed solemnly.

You may be able to get parts for repairing the
Junks from airships grounded in Achamoth.
The party decides to investigate.

Investigate the airship in the vicinity of
Achamoth's Main Entrance.

Investigate the airship in the vicinity of
Melfica Road.

Investigate the airship on the 2nd-level
mezzanine.
Return to Hermina.

Despite encountering a Telethia, you've found
some useful parts, but more will be needed.

Arara, a Nopon from Frontier Village, wants to collect
on a debt that Riki incurred. Find the ingredients, and a
chef, to create the dessert Arara has requested.

Search each region of the Giant God's Shoulder
for 7 [System:Color name=item ]Kilopumpkins[/System:Color].

Find a [System:Color name=item ]Sweet Cherry[/System:Color] along the banks of the
Tranquil Tarn.
Ask Tasheen in Gran Dell to prepare the dessert.

Talk to Arara and let him know that preparations
for making the dessert are complete.

The perfection of the meal and the party's efforts have
moved Arara deeply. The debt is forgiven and all is well.

Ines has misplaced the growth stimulant used to
nurture the wheat fields. Help her out by collecting
the necessary supplies.
Collect 5 [System:Color name=item ]High Leaves[/System:Color].

Defeat Skeeters at Xen's Thoroughfare and collect
4 globs of [System:Color name=item ]Thick Nectar[/System:Color] (clear weather only).
Return to Ines.

Ines is striving to increase the output from the fields.
(New collection points are available at Halcyon Wheats.)

Bartol wants to make a new-fangled fishing
device with Alfreda's help, but she can't do much
without the right components. Find them for her.
Collect 3 pieces of [System:Color name=item ]Snare Wire[/System:Color] and 3 [System:Color name=item ]Half Parts[/System:Color].
Collect the remaining [System:Color name=item ]Half Parts[/System:Color].
Hand over the machine parts to Alfreda.
Collect the remaining pieces of [System:Color name=item ]Snare Wire[/System:Color].

Give the Katchafish DX to Bartol
at Tranquil Tarn.

You've learnt how to use the Katchafish DX.
(New collection points are available at Tranquil Tarn.)

Radam has asked you to gather Glutton's Herbs so he
can finish his nutritional solution, "Radamalt³".
Gather 3 [System:Color name=item ]Glutton's Herbs[/System:Color].
Return to Radam.

"Radamalt³" is now finished! The name aside, at least
the product itself is reportedly quite tasteful.

When Kino approached little Angela playing all on
her own, it became clear that she was painfully shy.
Find her some friends so she won't be so lonely.

Sele should be somewhere with a good view
of the capital. Find and talk to her.

Nestor should be somewhere around Tranquil Tarn.
Find and talk to him.

Rudolph should be somewhere among Gran Dell's ruins.
Find and talk to her.
Return to Angela.

Kino played his part in helping Angela make some
new friends. Counting Kino, she now has four!

Angela wants to celebrate her new friendship.
Kino offers to make traditional Nopon friendship
bracelets for her, but will need materials first.

Collect 5 lengths of [System:Color name=item ]Elastic Ivy [/System:Color]in the woods along
Thulles Way.
Return to Angela.

Collect 5 [System:Color name=item ]Sparkle Stones [/System:Color]among the rocks
near the lake where the Junks landed.
Return to Angela.

The bracelets were to everyone's liking.
Putting them on will deepen their friendship.

Amleto is concerned about Winia's lack of cheer.
To bring a smile to her lips, he asks you to find a
craftsman who could craft a ring for her.
Find someone who can make you a ring.

Collect [System:Color name=item ]Brightite [/System:Color]in the stony area at the back
of the Forbidden Hushland.
Bring the [System:Color name=item ]Brightite [/System:Color]to Kurt.
Give the ring Kurt made to Amleto.

Amleto accepted the ring made by Kurt.
He even seemed somewhat satisfied...

Amleto and Kurt have gone to Zekr Marga Quarry.
It would be best to find them before they get
themselves into any mischief...
Find Amleto at Zekr Marga Quarry.
Find Kurt at Zekr Marga Quarry.
Talk to Winia and let her know both men are all right.

Amleto and Kurt have safely returned from the quarry.
This adventure has taught Winia a valuable lesson.

Tasheen wants to woo Taruko with a home-cooked meal.
Gather the three ingredients he'll need.
Gather 3 bunches of [System:Color name=item ]Cream Wheat[/System:Color].
Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Gentleclams[/System:Color].
Catch 3 [System:Color name=item ]Angel Breams[/System:Color].
Bring the ingredients to Tasheen.

Tasheen has what he needs to cook the meal.
All that's left is to pray for his safety...

The note's sender is waiting for Melia at
Companions' Cape. Let's go and meet them.
Go to Companions' Cape.
Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Resentful Gelgar[/System:Color].
Talk to Gelgar.

After a fierce battle, Melia and her friends
witnessed Gelgar's ultimate fate.

Some of the townspeople have been acting strangely
lately. Maxis would like you to get some information
from a certain Nopon who seems to be in the know.
Talk to Pororo.
Talk to Maxis about the "Mystery Drink".

Apprehend Bahn, who escaped towards the
Halcyon Wheats.

Defeat Bahn, who is waiting for you at the
Halcyon Wheats with weapons at the ready.

Talk to Bahn, who is acting contrite at the
Halcyon Wheats.

Bahn's great ambitions have been scuppered by Melia
and co. He can look forward to getting his just deserts.
